name: Grand Hyatt Bali

address.street: Kawasan Wisata Nusa Dua BTDC Nusa Dua

insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary in Nusa Dua perfectly balances Balinese tradition with contemporary luxury, offering unparalleled sunset views over the Indian Ocean.
whats_special: The Grand Hyatt Bali features traditional Balinese architecture with cascading waterfalls throughout the property, five distinct swimming pools including a lagoon-style pool with swim-up bar, and direct access to a pristine white sand beach. The resort sits on 40 acres of manicured tropical gardens and houses one of Bali's most authentic cultural villages where local artisans demonstrate traditional crafts.
pro_tip: Book the Regency Club for exclusive access to the clifftop lounge with panoramic ocean views - it's the perfect spot for sunset cocktails and includes complimentary breakfast and evening canapés.
dont_miss: The nightly Kecak fire dance performances at the resort's amphitheater, snorkeling at the nearby Nusa Dua reef (just steps from the beach), and treatments at the award-winning SpaGrand featuring traditional Balinese healing rituals in open-air pavilions overlooking the ocean.
pros: Prime beachfront location with direct access to Sanur Beach
Expansive tropical gardens and lagoon-style pools
Multiple dining venues featuring authentic Indonesian and international cuisine
Traditional Balinese spa treatments and wellness facilities
cons: Large resort property may feel less intimate
Popular venue can be busy during peak seasons
